Mission Viejo Minutes
  Special City Council Meeting
  March 31, 2021

Due to COVID-19 and the “Stay at Home” Order for the State of California and the Social
Distance Guidelines issued by Federal, State, and Local Authorities this Council Meeting was
conducted via Video Teleconferencing for all Council and Staff with the exception of the City
Attorney and City Clerk who were present in the Council Chamber. All public comments that
were emailed to the City Clerk were read during the meeting.

A Special Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Financing Authority, the
Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency, the Housing Authority, and the Library
Board of Trustees of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor Kelley at
5:02 p.m., on March 31, 2021, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted by
5:00 p.m. on March 29, 2021, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. A copy was also posted at
the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive and Norman P. Murray
Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Teleconferenced:  Council Member Goodell
  Council Member Raths (arrived at 5:04 p.m.)
  Council Member Sachs
  Mayor Pro Tem Bucknum
  Mayor Kelley

Absent:  None

Staff  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
Teleconferenced:  Keith Rattay, Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services
  Cheryl Dyas, Director of Administrative Services

Staff Present:  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk
  Renata Winter, Assistant City Clerk

CLOSED SESSION

CS1. Conference with Real Property Negotiators: Stein Mart Property 25282 Marguerite
  Parkway; Agency Negotiators: Dennis Wilberg, Keith Rattay, Elaine Lister, Cheryl
  Dyas and William Curley. Negotiating Party: Kinstler Family Trust. Under Negotiation-
  Price and Terms.

City Council Minutes  1  March 31, 2021
   Cathy Schlicht, M.V.: Questioned when the public discussion on the need or the intended use
  for the proposed government purchase of this private property.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION AND RECONVENE

At the hour of 5:07 p.m., Mayor Kelley recessed the meeting to Closed Session. The City Council
reconvened at 5:53 p.m. with all five City Council Members present.

REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

City Attorney Bill Curley stated that price and term information was presented to the City Council
and direction was given but there was no reportable action.

INVOCATION: Council Member Raths

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Goodell

PUBLIC COMMENTS

OPEN SESSION

1.  Formation of the “Stein Mart Acquisition Ad Hoc Committee”

  Cathy Schlicht, M.V.: Questioned the fiduciary responsibility to its voters to be transparent and
  faithful to the tenets of open government and feels that the formation of an ad hoc committee
  contributes to the lack of transparency by the City Council.

  City Attorney Bill Curley responded that for the record, before the Council went into Closed
  Session to initially consider this item, there was a verbal overview and it was linked to the staff
  report for item 8 at the February 23 Council Meeting. That was presented in writing, and the
  public was informed and had the ability to see and comment. The City Council has done
  everything exactly and above what the law requires and for anybody to assert otherwise is very
  misplaced.

  Mayor Kelley announced that she has asked at an upcoming meeting there will be a presentation
  of the Core Vision Plan.

  Mayor Kelley appointed Council Member Goodell, and Council Member Sachs to the Stein
  Mart Acquisition Ad Hoc Committee.

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 6:00 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this special
session, Mayor Kelley adjourned the City Council meeting to Tuesday April 13, 2021 at 5:00 p.m.

City Council Minutes  2  March 31, 2021
 ______________________________________
Renata Winter, Assistant City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of April 13, 2021

City Council Minutes  3  March 31, 2021
